description:
*AREONIX | From Earth to the Stars*

We are a team of passionate innovators exploring how Earth's extreme environments can help humanity prepare for life on the Moon and Mars. Combining AI, data science, technology, and creative problem-solving, we aim to turn bold ideas into real solutions.

 We're looking for curious minds skilled in AI, coding, geospatial analysis, design, or space science.

*Think beyond Earth. Build beyond limits.*
